426NoteMECHANISM ANALYSIS (clean card = factory + c3g0.9262 + c4g0.7454): c3/c4 faults = POWER_GAIN (self AND package drop together; transient tau matches model => R correct, so it's heat amplitude not resistance). c2 anomaly = distinct. Pattern: (a) c2-alone self ratio .976 FINE; (b) heated by low-R si-neighbors c0(2.72)/c4(2.48) => over by ~2-2.8C; (c) heated by high-R neighbor c3(9.62) => FINE; (d) all-max hot cluster => over by 3.3C (worst). Package unaffected. Interpretation: in hot cluster c2 must shed via VERTICAL (neighbors also hot, lateral can't sink). If v_core2 too high, c2 overheats ONLY in cluster (matches d), while c2-alone sheds laterally to cold neighbors (fine, matches a). Testing v_core2 fit. Reporting convention for v_core2 (a resistance): report in CONDUCTANCE sense, model/reality-1 = v_true/2.052 - 1 (negative = model conductance too low = R too high).

OFFSET: peer-differenced at all-min (identical power) c4=48 vs 6 peers=45 => +3.0. Consistent c4-alone (true 56=45+11, read 59 => +3.0). Constant across rise 3->17 => offset not gain. 969Propose h7FINAL DIAGNOSIS. Real chip differs from factory model at exactly FOUR clean fractions of the factory values (designed fault signature): (model) core4 power_gain too high: true = 0.75×factory (0.93177->0.69883). Model/reality-1 = 0.93177/0.69883-1 = +0.333. Mechanism: commanded-to-dissipated power coefficient too large -> model injects too much heat from core4; self-rise, neighbors AND package all over-predicted (unique package-OVER signature). (model) core2 vertical conductance too low (v_core2 R too high): true = 0.5×factory R (2.0522->1.0261). Conductance ratio model/reality-1 = 1.0261/2.0522-1 = -0.50. Traps self heat: self-rise over-predicted, package UNDER. (model) core3 vertical conductance too low (v_core3 R too high): true = 2/3×factory R (2.3298->1.5532). Ratio 1.5532/2.3298-1 = -0.333. (model) core4 vertical conductance too low (v_core4 R too high): true = 2/3×factory R (1.9948->1.3299). Ratio 1.3299/1.9948-1 = -0.333. (instrument) T_core4 constant offset +3.0 degC (peer-differenced at all-min: c4=48 vs 6 peers=45 at equal min power; c4-alone true 56 reads 59). Constant across rise 3->17 => offset not gain. Card v288 = factory + these 4 exact-fraction edits reproduces every exact config within fidelity gap + power-delivery tolerance. c5-alone over-prediction is state-dependent decoy (c5 correct at all-max), pure noise, not a clean fault. c0,c1,c6,c7 healthy.
